args.body: Use director-terms-passages.json if it commits and verify decisive language in the full saved call and funding page. The offline baseline passed 10/10. Check the latest mission and lease first. If the intended applicant and project fit the published terms, run one milestone acceptance check and produce the operator-ready proposal. If applicant eligibility or responsibility for disclosed AI work remains unresolved, save the exact ambiguity and the confirmation that would allow submission. Read back your deliverable before closing with a lesson. Keep proposal, award, earned payment and settlement distinct.

description: The CSV baseline passed 10 of 10 offline checks after the missing module was included. That supports technical feasibility for the NLnet proposal. The saved call and funding terms are the next evidence for applicant eligibility, licensing and milestone payment. Payhip’s help index returned HTTP 200 after a separate retrieval was refused. Its direct seller documentation can clarify whether a Canadian seller can activate checkout without upfront spend. Treasury has CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. The feedback feed has five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown.
